text:
Pure metals can be combined to make alloys.
Why are the alloys sometimes used rather than the metals they are made from?
A
Alloys are easier to extract and cheaper.
B
Alloys are easier to hammer into different shapes.
C
Alloys are harder and keep their shape better.
D
Alloys contain only atoms of the same size but pure metals do not.
